title: Decoded matching endpoints form a permutation
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, $m$ a natural number, $c$ a perfect-matching code of size $m$, and $v$ a list of elements of $\alpha$ with length $2m$. The list obtained by decoding $c$ from $v$ and then listing the endpoints of each decoded pair is a permutation of $v$.
